newsitem.title: USA: ASA Holdings Inc March load factor flat.
newsitem.headline: ASA Holdings Inc March load factor flat.

text.p: Atlantic Southeast Airlines Inc, a subsidiary of ASA Holdings Inc, said on Wednesday that its March load factor was 49.7 percent as compared to 49.8 percent in 1996.
Revenue passenger miles increased to 78.4 million in March 1997, a 1.6 percent increase over the same period last year. Available seat miles in March increased to 157.6 million from 154.9 million.
Atlantic Southeast said its load factor on a year-to-date basis increased to 47.0 percent for the first three months of 1997 as compared with 46.7 percent in the previous year.

The company also said its revenue passenger miles increased to 203.8 million for the first three months of 1997 as compared with 201.4 million for 1996, while available seat miles increased to 433.2 million for the first three months of 1997 from 431.7 million.
